explanation: Translated the Java `LuhnCheckDigit` and `ModulusCheckDigit` classes faithfully into Python. Preserved UTF-16 code unit semantics when indexing strings (using `_to_utf16_code_units`). Implemented `GenericValidator.isBlankOrNull` checks matching Java semantics. Implemented `run(operation, data)` to handle `calculate` (returning string or raising `ValueError`) and `isValid` (returning boolean).
